identity_policy: engine/us_short_eligibility_gate.py::canonical_us_ticker; one canonical identity per stock; plain str only
theme_momentum_policy: theme_momentum_score uses the scored theme block when present; neutral or missing theme evidence maps to 0.0 for theme seats while core_score still applies its neutral-block rule

input_contract.projection_partition_policy: For each component, scored value identities plus neutral_fill_tickers must exactly partition target_tickers; coverage must exactly cover target_tickers; target_count and scored_count must match.
input_contract.risk_downgrade_policy: risk_downgrade_by_ticker must exactly cover target_tickers; every row must validate as engine.us_short_risk_downgrade.validate_risk_downgrade_input output; missing does not default to zero.

output_contract.same_run_reconciliation: selection_inputs.per_ticker[ticker].core_score is composed from the same score_blocks, risk_downgrade, and scoring_profile carried to analysis_by_ticker[ticker]; a section 4.3 chasing_extreme ticker uses the theme_off profile on both the selection and analysis side so the one core_score per run invariant holds.
